description: Comprehensive official public holidays of Saudi Arabia (al-A3yad al-Rasmiya fi al-Mamlaka al-Arabiya al-Saudiya) from 1990 through 2030, generated algorithmically by the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT). Each record carries the Gregorian date plus the holiday name in all three vacanza-supported languages: Arabic (ar, native default), Bengali (bn — for Bangladeshi expatriate workers, the largest foreign labor community in Saudi Arabia), and English (en_US). Includes the seven core Islamic holidays — Eid al-Fitr Day 1-3 (1-3 Shawwal, plus 4 Shawwal if not a long Ramadan), Arafat Day (9 Dhu al-Hijjah), and Eid al-Adha Day 1-3 (10-12 Dhu al-Hijjah) — computed via the official Umm al-Qura calendar (confirmed dates 2001-2025; estimated outside that range). Also includes the two modern state holidays: National Day / al-Yawm al-Watani (23 September, post-2005) and Founding Day / Yawm al-Tasis (22 February, post-2022 per Royal Order of 27 Jan 2022). Observed replacement days apply: Thu→prev Wed + Fri→next Sat (pre-2013, when the Saudi weekend was Thu-Fri) and Fri→prev Thu + Sat→next Sun (post-28 June 2013, when the weekend shifted to Fri-Sat). Saudi Arabia has no subdivisions in vacanza (single national list — although administratively the Kingdom has 13 regions / manatiq).
